abstract: A 5-month-old-male was brought to our hospital in April 2004 with left scrotal swelling. His serum alpha-fetoprotein AFP and human chorionic gonadotropin-beta levels were 6,862.9 and < 0.1 ng/ml, respectively. Computed tomography (CT) revealed no metastasis. Left high ligation of testis was performed. Pathological examination demonstrated Yolk sac tumor. He is alive without evidence of recurrence for 53 months postoperatively.
abstract_ja: 5か月齢の男児が、左陰嚢腫脹を主訴に当院を受診した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は6,862.9 ng/ml、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβ(hCG-β)値は<0.1 ng/mlであった。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では転移を認めなかった。左精巣の高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理学的検査で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。術後53か月の時点で再発の所見なく生存している。
